protocol: Repeated shuffled group-exclusive outer CV with a group-exclusive inner validation split for early stopping.

models.shared_mtl_nn: Shared 6->128->128->64 SiLU trunk and one 64->32->1 SiLU head per target; equal standardized MSE across the two targets.
models.independent_stl_nn: Two separately trained networks, each matching one complete input-to-head path of the MTL network, including the full trunk and head.
models.random_forest: Deterministic multi-output RandomForestRegressor fitted to the same standardized inner-training data.
models.shared_mtl_nn_mgda: Same architecture as shared_mtl_nn, trained with the MGDA trainer: per-task gradients on the shared trunk, exact two-task min-norm combination, shared-trunk gradient replaced (not accumulated) after head backprop.
models.separate_mtl_nn: Two-head port of the thesis Separate family: one shared 6->128 SiLU layer, then one 128->128->1 SiLU branch per target; the original output ReLU is removed because targets are standardized. Equal standardized MSE trainer.
models.separate_mtl_nn_mgda: separate_mtl_nn architecture trained with the MGDA trainer.
models.deep_balanced_mtl_nn: Two-head port of the thesis Deep_Balanced family: shared 6->200->100 SiLU trunk with dropout 0.5, energy-style head 100->50->25->1 for heating energy and comfort-style head 100->25->12->1 for days below 24 C. Equal standardized MSE trainer.
models.deep_balanced_mtl_nn_mgda: deep_balanced_mtl_nn architecture trained with the MGDA trainer.
models.gradient_boosting: Per-target HistGradientBoostingRegressor fitted to the same standardized inner-training data; max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.1, no early stopping, seeded per fold and target.
models.initialization: Kaiming uniform for all linear weights; zero biases.

decision_validation.true_score_regret_definition: Exact-objective weighted score of the surrogate-selected configuration minus the exact optimum score, using min-max bounds from the exact Pareto front.

days_prediction_policy.raw_oof_and_point_metrics: Unclipped predicted days_below_24_c values are preserved and used for all MAE, RMSE, and R2 metrics.
days_prediction_policy.pareto_and_weighted_profile_decisions: Predicted days_below_24_c is clipped to the physically admissible closed interval [0, 365] immediately before constructing predicted Pareto fronts and weighted-profile selections. No other prediction is clipped.
